build_PointTransformerV3_model: build a PointTransformerV3 model for 3D point cloud segmentation with configurable encoder decoder stages
run_PointTransformerV3_forward: run the PointTransformerV3 forward pass on a batched point cloud data dictionary to get features
create_Point_serialization: create serialized point cloud codes using z-order or hilbert space-filling curves for attention patches
create_Point_sparsify: create a spconv SparseConvTensor from point cloud features and grid coordinates for sparse convolution
review_SerializedAttention_flash: review the SerializedAttention module to understand flash attention and relative positional encoding support
